library.title: Style library
library.subtitle: Ready-made descriptions of how a picture should look. Pick one in the chat, or make your own.

kindHint.style: Describes the whole look of the picture: colours, mood, composition.
kindHint.photo_style: Describes how the photo is taken: light, camera, lens, mood.

library.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, text or category
library.emptyText: Try other words or another category.
library.emptyMineText: Make a new one, or open a built-in style and copy it to Mine to change it.

details.fieldsHint: An empty field takes the value shown in it, or drops out of the text.
details.fieldDropped: If empty, it is left out
details.resultHint: When you use the style, this text is added to your request. Showing it is free: no AI is called.
details.removedNote: This style is no longer in the library that ships with the app. Works that already use it keep working.
details.deleteConfirm: Delete the style “{title}”? Its picture stays in the media library.

editor.descriptionPlaceholder: A few words for yourself: when to use it
editor.promptPlaceholder: Describe how the picture should look
editor.promptHint: Put a thing to fill in later inside double curly brackets, for example {example}. The words after the vertical bar are used when the field is left empty.
editor.noFields: No fields: the text is used as it is.
editor.zonesHint: Where the words sit on the picture, as JSON. Leave empty if you do not need it.
editor.previewHint: Shown in the library and in the style picker.
editor.previewKept: A removed or replaced picture stays in the media library.

errors.library_builtin_readonly: Built-in styles cannot be changed. Copy the style to Mine and change the copy.
errors.library_too_many_variables: Too many fields in the text: at most {max}.
errors.library_bad_image: This file is not a picture. Upload PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.text_zones_too_large: Text zones are too large: at most {max_chars} characters.
errors.text_zones_invalid_json: Text zones are not valid JSON.
errors.text_zones_not_an_object: Text zones must be a JSON object with a list of zones.
